scientific_integrity: Underlying factorized stationary law and generic mutual-information identities are credited to prior work. Mathematical review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Stationary four-direction harmonic model at equal turning/trap rates only; positive-noise angle optimum and noncompact scaled-angle uniformity are not proved. Entropy is snapshot mutual information, not entropy production. Prior general entropy results might implicitly cover portions of the theorem.
title: A universal angular-information boundary layer for a noisy quarter-turn swimmer
